title: Nope!!! Don't Buy!
text: Ummm...No!!! Not as decribed. I received missing products, along w/ nothing but sample size crap. I had to fight to get my money back, lol. And then I canceled, of course. These boxes are not what they use to send o/. They're double the price (also) for less than half the product they promised to send (as stated in description) I'm not sure if it's b/c I ordered this through Amazon, instead of directly from Allure. Idk. But, No Thank You ☠
label: negative
